name: Care Closet @ NKU
address: University Center 142, Nunn Drive, Highland Heights, KY 41099
limitations: Student clothing service, not a general-public shop or the separate Newport CARE Closet. No on-site audit. The hours panel is labeled Spring 2026; current term and holiday hours remain unconfirmed. The current campus-map link shows June 2025 revision text and construction markings; another official-host version has different building numbering. Both print a $9.75 garage maximum, unlike the visitor page’s 2026–27 $12 rate. The map is orientation only, not current construction or door-operation evidence. A continuous step-free route to UC 142, elevator location, aisle clearance, fitting-room access, toilets/changing facilities and clothing-selection assistance remain unverified. Official room photographs are undated and may show earlier layouts.

The Care Closet @ NKU offers free clothing to assist NKU students in finding appropriate interview wear and everyday needs. Visit our location University Center 142.
Students must have their All Card to shop with us.

Students may collect items for other people if they tell the service. Children’s clothing is held at the Newport home base and must be requested for collection at NKU; it is not promised as NKU walk-in stock.
https://www.nku.edu/care-closet/
operator_official
Can I take items for other people? Yes! We just ask that you let us know so we can better understand who we are helping in the community.
We have all kinds of clothes for babies and children of all ages at our home base in Newport. Just complete our online form and we will pull a bag together and arrange to get it to you.
Email Amy Kees to request your items and ask to pick up these items at the Care Closet @ NKU.

Clothing donations are not generally accepted at NKU. For a few suitable, clean items in good condition, email a list to carecloset@nku.edu and coordinate a drop-off time; do not assume walk-in donation service.
https://www.nku.edu/care-closet/
operator_official

We do not generally accept clothing donations; however, if you believe that you have a few* items that will benefit our college students, are on-trend, and are clean, in good condition and free of tears or holes, you can email carecloset@nku.edu with a list of donation items. A drop-off time must be coordinated with the Care Closet.

For visitors using designated disability spaces, NKU requires both a state-issued disability placard and a Parking Services permit. Its Nunn Drive office lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; summer hours may vary. Confirm arrangements at 859-572-5505.
https://www.nku.edu/parking/visit/
operator_official
Handicap spaces are available to visitors with ADA needs. These spaces require a valid state issued handicap placard and a permit issued by Parking Services.
Please stop by the Parking Services on Nunn Drive between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. to obtain a permit Monday-Thursday or 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. on Friday (summer hours may vary).
If you have specific visitor parking questions please call us at (859) 572-5505.
cognitive

Visitor garages are Arena, University and Kenton. Pull a ticket even if the gate is raised; payment accepts Visa, MasterCard or Discover. The 2026–27 table lists $12 for stays over four hours or a lost ticket. Departmental validation is possible but not promised for this service.
https://www.nku.edu/parking/visit/
operator_official
Visitor parking is located in the Arena Garage, University Garage, and Kenton Garages
Always pull a ticket as you enter the garage, even if the gates are up.
Garages accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover
Some departments validate parking, be sure to check with department prior to heading back to vehicle.
Garage Rates (26-27)
4.0 Hours + $12.00 Lost Ticket $12.00

Surface lots require a permit. A visitor day permit can be bought online for $12, printed and displayed on the dashboard; it applies only to the registered vehicle in Student Parking or Permit Parking lots.
https://www.nku.edu/parking/visit/
operator_official
All vehicles must possess a permit to park in surface lots.
Visitors can purchase a pass from the parking office or visitors can purchase a printable day permit online for $12/day.
The permit must be displayed on your dashboard and can only be used in the Student Parking or Permit Parking lots. The permit can only be used in the vehicle that was assigned to the permit.
